mapper.sql: FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection connection LEFT JOIN model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_publication publication ON publication.connection_id = connection.id AND publication.connection_revision = connection.version AND connection.status = 'VERIFIED' WHERE connection.scope = 'PLATFORM' AND concat_ws(' ', connection.display_name, CASE connection.provider_preset_id WHEN 'CUSTOM' THEN '自定义连接' WHEN 'DEEPSEEK' THEN 'DeepSeek' WHEN 'ALIYUN' THEN '阿里云百炼' WHEN 'SILICONFLOW' THEN '硅基流动' WHEN 'VOLCENGINE' THEN '火山方舟' ELSE '已有连接' END, CASE connection.capability_intent WHEN 'CHAT' THEN '对话模型' WHEN 'EMBEDDING' THEN '向量模型' WHEN 'RERANK' THEN '重排序模型' ELSE '待确认' END, CASE WHEN connection.capability_intent = 'RERANK' THEN '厂商重排适配' WHEN connection.provider_kind = 'OPENAI_COMPATIBLE' THEN 'OpenAI 兼容协议' ELSE '待确认协议' END, CASE WHEN connection.status = 'DISABLED' THEN '已停用' WHEN connection.last_probe_succeeded = FALSE THEN '失败' WHEN publication.id IS NOT NULL THEN '已发布' WHEN connection.status = 'VERIFIED' THEN '验证通过' ELSE '草稿' END) ILIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\'
mapper.select: SELECT connection.* ORDER BY connection.created_at DESC, connection.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection connection JOIN model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_publication publication ON publication.connection_id = connection.id AND publication.connection_revision = connection.version WHERE connection.scope = 'PLATFORM' AND connection.status = 'VERIFIED'

SELECT connection.id AS connection_id, connection.version, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_credential credential WHERE credential.platform_provider_connection_id = connection.id AND credential.credential_purpose = 'INFERENCE_API_KEY') AS credential_configured, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_credential credential WHERE credential.platform_provider_connection_id = connection.id AND credential.credential_purpose = 'DISCOVERY_ACCESS_KEY_ID') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_credential credential WHERE credential.platform_provider_connection_id = connection.id AND credential.credential_purpose = 'DISCOVERY_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')) AS discovery_credentials_configured, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_publication publication WHERE publication.connection_id = connection.id AND publication.connection_revision = connection.version AND connection.status = 'VERIFIED') AS published FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection connection WHERE connection.id IN #{id}
